facts.fact: The Federal Ministry of Health says the Nigeria Digital Health Initiative, launched in March 2024 and endorsed by the National Council on Health in November 2024, includes a Health Information Exchange for data sharing across public and private facilities, to unify DHIS2, SORMAS, NHIA systems, LMIS and electronic medical records, for delivery before May 2027.
facts.system: Nigeria Digital Health Initiative (Health Information Exchange)
